description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《[如何保证幂等性](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》。
description.en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence).

description.zh: 有效周期的时间范围，当**ValidityType**为**time_bound**时生效。
description.en: The time range of the validity period. This parameter is valid only when you set **ValidityType** to **time\_bound**.

description.zh:
关系有效期类型，取值可选范围：
- permanent：永久
- time_bound：自定义时间范围
description.en:
The validity period type. Valid values:

- permanent: The authorization is permanent.

- time\_bound: The authorization is valid for a custom time range.
